description: This file defines the CheckoutActivity class for an Android application, handling user interactions, form data binding, coupon management, payment processing UI, and navigation upon order placement in an online shopping platform.

classes.name: CheckoutActivity
classes.description: Android activity for managing the checkout process, including form handling, coupon application, payment method selection, and navigation to order confirmation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, binds view model state, and configures event listeners.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the activity's toolbar title and navigation icon.

methods.name: setupPaymentMethodUi
methods.description: Synchronizes UI radio buttons with the current selected payment method.

methods.name: setupFormListeners
methods.description: Sets up text change listeners and click handlers for form fields and buttons, including coupon and payment options.

methods.name: setupCouponSuggestions
methods.description: Prepares the dropdown adapter and item click behavior for coupon code input.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Collects flow-based UI state updates from the view model and updates UI components accordingly.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Enables/disables UI elements and shows/hides progress bar based on loading state.

methods.name: setAllEnabled
methods.description: Recursively enables or disables all views within a container.

methods.name: showManageSavedCouponsDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with saved coupons, allowing selection or removal.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Entry point for activity creation, setting up UI and binding to ViewModel.
